title: Delta delivers limited-time fares and special Delta Comfort upgrade offers
summary: Explore flight and upgrade offers to and from Seattle and Alaska during Delta's limited time fall retail event.|
body_markdown:
***Editor's note:** The Delta Comfort upgrade offers and Seattle promotional fares have ended, but Alaskan SkyMiles Members can still take advantage of savings through Oct. 20.*


Delta is making authentic adventures and dream getaways easier with a limited-time fare sale for customers traveling to and from Seattle or Alaska, featuring deals on flights across Delta's domestic network and special offers on Delta Comfort.


### **Alaskan SkyMiles Members save on select destinations**


From the beaches of Florida to the islands of Hawaii and the grand, diverse landscapes of the Southwest, Delta is making it easier for Alaskans to trade snow for sunshine.


From Oct. 6 through 20,[Alaskan SkyMiles Members can take advantage of exclusive promotional fares](https://www.delta.com/us/en/flight-deals/flights-from-alaska) for roundtrip flights from Anchorage (ANC) and Fairbanks (FAI) to popular destinations across the U.S. for travel between Oct. 17, 2026, and May 15, 2027.


**Destinations** : Fort Lauderdale (FLL), Tampa (TPA), Orlando (MCO), Las Vegas (LAS), Phoenix (PHX), Palm Springs (PSP), San Diego (SAN), Tucson (TUS), Los Angeles (LAX), San Francisco (SFO), Honolulu (HNL), Kauai (LIH), Kona (KOA) and Maui (OGG).


# Alaska Promotional Fares


From relaxing on world-famous beaches and exploring vibrant cities to hiking desert landscapes and discovering island adventures, Delta connects Alaskans to some of the most sought-after destinations across North America.


*These limited-time offers are available on eligible Anchorage and Fairbanks-originating itineraries during the promotional period (Oct. 6 – 20) and are subject to availability. Terms and baggage fees apply.*


### **Save on all Delta domestic nonstop destinations to and from Seattle**


Whether customers are planning a winter getaway, family visit or long weekend escape, Delta is offering promotional fares on all of its nearly 50 domestic nonstop destinations to and from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA).


Customers traveling between Hawaii and Seattle can save even more. With nonstop service between Seattle and four unique destinations in Hawaii – Honolulu (HNL), Maui (OGG), Kona (KOA) and Lihue (LIH) – customers can enjoy all that the paradise of the Pacific has to offer.


Delta’s best offers for Seattleites, including these limited-time promotional fares, can always be found at[www.delta.com/seattledeals](http://www.delta.com/seattledeals) .


*These limited-time offers are available on eligible Seattle itineraries during the promotional period and are subject to availability. Terms and baggage fees apply.*


### **A special nod to the 12s: Delta Comfort upgrades from $12 for roundtrip flights**


To celebrate the energy and passion of the[Seattle Seahawks’ 12s fanbase](https://news.delta.com/first-and-10-12status-program-kicks-decade-awarding-seattle-seahawks-fans) as the team defends their Championship title, Delta – the Official Airline of the Seattle Seahawks –[is offering Delta Comfort upgrades starting at just $12 on eligible roundtrip Seattle flights](https://www.delta.com/us/en/flight-deals/premium-cabin-flight-deals?dlid=DNH_FALLFLASH-SEA-AK_DNH-TXT-SEACPLUS12D_202610) , including on sale fares.


**Delta Comfort offers:**


- More legroom


- Early boarding with Zone 3


- Dedicated overhead bin space


- Complimentary beer, wine and spirits for customers 21+ on eligible flights


- Enhanced comfort for the journey ahead


*This limited-time offer is available on eligible Seattle itineraries booked during the promotional period (Oct. 5 – 8) and is subject to availability. Available only on new revenue bookings of Delta-marketed and -operated nonstop Seattle itineraries within the travel dates and destinations referenced in the above Seattle Deals page; $6 upsell price each way, roundtrip purchase required, compared to Delta Main Classic fares for the same flight.*


### **Delta's first-ever $1 Delta Comfort upgrade offer for Alaska itineraries**


Delta is also extending a special, limited-time upgrade offer from Oct. 5 – 8 to Delta Comfort for customers traveling to and from Alaska.


For the first time ever, customers traveling on Delta nonstop flights – as well as one-stop flights to select Florida destinations (TPA, FLL, MIA and MCO) – to and from Anchorage (ANC) or Fairbanks (FAI)[can purchase a Delta Comfort upgrade for just $1 each way](https://www.delta.com/us/en/flight-deals/premium-cabin-flight-deals) , including on eligible sale fares.


In addition, promotional fares for select nonstop flights between Anchorage or Fairbanks and Seattle will be featured in the flash sale.


Delta Comfort provides customers traveling on Alaska flight itineraries with the same enhanced premium experience, including extra legroom, dedicated space for carry-on bags, priority boarding and complimentary alcoholic beverages for 21+ customers on eligible flights.


*These limited-time offers are available on eligible Anchorage and Fairbanks itineraries booked during the promotional period (Oct. 5 – 8) and are subject to availability. Available only on new revenue bookings of Delta-marketed and -operated nonstop itineraries originating from ANC or FAI, for itineraries within the travel dates and destinations referenced in the above Alaska Deals page; upsell price is each way, roundtrip purchase required, compared to Delta Main Classic fares for the same flight.*


### **Delta in Seattle and Alaska**


As Seattle's premium global carrier, Delta offers access to more than 60 destinations across Asia, Europe and the Americas, making it easier than ever for customers to explore the world from the Pacific Northwest.


In summer 2026, Delta introduced nonstop flights from Seattle to Barcelona and Rome, and, in March 2027, the airline will launch nonstop service **between Seattle and Tokyo-Narita International Airport** . Operating daily on the Airbus A330-900neo, the route will complement Delta's existing nonstop service to Tokyo-Haneda, giving customers even more ways to visit the destination.


[A new way to Tokyo: Delta to launch new Seattle–Tokyo Narita service in March 2027](https://news.delta.com/new-way-tokyo-delta-launch-new-seattle-tokyo-narita-service-march-2027)


With nonstop service to both Haneda and Narita, Delta will provide customers with its most comprehensive Seattle-Tokyo offering ever, reinforcing Seattle's role as Delta’s premier Pacific gateway and giving customers even greater access to Japan.


In addition to the Seahawks, Delta is the Official Airline of the Seattle Sounders FC and contributes meaningfully to the Emerald City and Alaska through community engagement, annual giving programs and leadership commitments to several organizations.


The airline also plays an important role in connecting Alaska to Seattle and beyond, providing year-round service from communities across the state and seamless access to Delta's expansive domestic and international network. With nonstop service from Anchorage to Delta’s key hubs in Atlanta (ATL), Detroit (DTW), Minneapolis (MSP), Salt Lake City (SLC) and Seattle, Delta offers nearly 300 one-stop destinations to Alaskans.


Delta helps connect Alaska residents and visitors to destinations around the globe through Seattle, while supporting tourism, business travel and economic opportunity throughout the region.


With deep ties to Seattle, a strong presence across Alaska and the Pacific Northwest, and a leading global network, Delta continues to make the region a launchpad for adventure, connection and discovery.
